en.title: Find Maximum Greatness
en.description:
Rearrange the array to maximize the number of indices where rearranged[i] > arr[i].

See "Input" for the standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.explanation: Sort, then greedily match each element with the smallest feasible strictly larger element.
